en.title: The 90/180 rolling window
en.subtitle: The window slides every day

steps.label: Today
steps.text: 30 + 45 = 75 days used, so 15 of your 90 remain

en.focal: Arrival and departure days both count
en.alt: Timeline diagram of the Schengen 90/180 rolling window: from 180 days ago to today, two trips of 30 and 45 days use 75 of 90 days, leaving 15; the window slides every day and arrival and departure days both count
en.caption: The window never resets: for every single day, the previous 180 days may hold at most 90 days of stay.
